props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game prop sprite atlas for a Brazilian school arcade beat-em-up. Reference image 1: palette, painted arcade style, perspective and warm afternoon lighting. Create EIGHT clearly separated full objects on a genuinely transparent background in a STRICT 4 columns by 2 rows grid, each completely inside its own cell with generous transparent margins. Row 1 left to right: a sturdy school cafeteria rectangular wooden table with four tubular dark metal legs; a matching wooden school chair with back and four metal legs; a tall vintage teal vending machine with cream front panel and visible soda cans behind glass (NO LETTERS); a tall wooden library bookcase full of books. Row 2 left to right: a stainless laboratory cylindrical reagent tank on small sturdy base with teal glowing liquid glass window; an industrial server electrical control cabinet with thick bundled hanging cables all integrated into a single cohesive upright cabinet; a small red and ivory first aid satchel with white cross; a single metallic orange soda can. All eight assets shown from the SAME arcade camera: front-facing, slightly visible top and right side, near orthographic shallow 3/4 view, feet on baseline. Solid detailed hand-painted materials, grounded proportions, highlights upper left, shaded lower right. NOT flat vector, NOT icons, NOT 3D toy, NOT photoreal. Main six objects comparable real-world scale but complete inside cells; reference character human height 294px, table height 115px, chair115px, machine250px, shelf310px, tank160px,cabinet260px, satchel40px,can30px. No background, no floor, no baked outside shadows, no labels, no scenery, no people, no text, no watermark. Clean isolated alpha silhouettes, no overlap between cells.

walks.gelton: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production character locomotion animation sprite sheet. Reference image: EXISTING gelton playable character, preserve exact face identity, hair, eyewear if any, hat if any, costume, shoes or bare feet, physique and painted arcade rendering. Create a STRICT FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS atlas of EIGHT complete full-body frames of ONE coherent right-facing walk cycle, left to right then next row. Animation contact left foot, down, passing, up, contact right foot, down, passing, up. Natural arcade beat-em-up forward walking, narrow relaxed guard (NOT wide static martial arts stance), strong weight transfer, knees flexing, alternating arms, visible different positions of BOTH legs at every stage. Same character in all frames, constant head dimensions, constant limb proportions and spine length; small vertical body bounce is allowed. Entire feet, hands, hat/hair always contained in each grid cell with generous transparent margins and equal cell sizes. Bodies pelvis centered in each cell and feet share a ground baseline. No exaggerated kick, no pose swapping between two static stances. Flat shallow three-quarter camera same as reference, character facing right. Crisp solid opaque painted silhouettes with genuine transparent background. NO labels, no text, no cell borders, no scenery, no shadows outside body, no extra props, no other characters. Original face must remain recognizable and NOT copied from a different character.
